name: Proficiency
title: German at Its Full Range
tagline: Move between registers, irony and precision like a native speaker.
overview: C2 is mastery with awareness. You will examine the choices advanced speakers make — between tenses, between the subjunctive and the indicative, between a precise word and a nearly right one. The work is analytical, literary and rhetorical, with German as the working language of the classroom.
levelGoal: By the end of C2 you can understand virtually everything you read or hear, express yourself with precision and spontaneity, and navigate irony, literature and professional nuance with confidence.
canDo: Understand literary, academic and highly idiomatic German.
Express subtle differences in meaning, tone and register.
Debate complex issues fluently and spontaneously.
Produce polished academic and professional texts.

modules.title: Precision & Style
modules.summary: The last mile: grammatical distinctions, stylistic choices and regional awareness.

lessons.title: Advanced Grammatical Distinctions
lessons.summary: Choose between near-synonymous structures when the difference actually matters.
objectives: Distinguish subtle tense and mood differences.
Use the subjunctive for distance, hypothesis and politeness.
Explain the effect of a grammatical choice on meaning.

keyPhrase.de: Hätte man früher gehandelt, wäre das vermeidbar gewesen.
keyPhrase.en: Had action been taken earlier, that would have been avoidable.

lessons.title: Stylistic Fine-Tuning
lessons.summary: Vary sentence rhythm, choose the precise verb and remove what the text does not need.
objectives: Replace generic verbs with more precise alternatives.
Vary sentence length for emphasis and readability.
Explain why one stylistic choice works better than another.

keyPhrase.de: Der Text ist stilistisch überarbeitet worden.
keyPhrase.en: The text has been revised stylistically.

lessons.title: Regional Variation
lessons.summary: Hear the difference between standard German, Austrian and Swiss usage — and regional colour.
objectives: Recognise common Austrian and Swiss vocabulary.
Understand regional pronunciation differences.
Decide when regional forms are appropriate in writing.

keyPhrase.de: Diese Redewendung ist im Süden geläufiger als im Norden.
keyPhrase.en: This expression is more common in the south than in the north.

modules.title: Literature & Rhetoric
modules.summary: Read between the lines and learn how German persuades.

lessons.title: Literary Language & Analysis
lessons.summary: Narrative voice, imagery and ambiguity in German literature.
objectives: Analyse narrative perspective and voice.
Identify imagery and its effect.
Write a short literary interpretation in German.

keyPhrase.de: Der Erzähler lässt die Grenze zwischen Traum und Wirklichkeit verschwimmen.
keyPhrase.en: The narrator blurs the boundary between dream and reality.

lessons.title: Rhetorical Structures
lessons.summary: Recognise and use rhetorical devices without sounding like a textbook.
objectives: Identify antithesis, repetition and rhetorical questions.
Use emphasis and contrast effectively in a speech.
Evaluate the persuasive effect of a rhetorical choice.

keyPhrase.de: Nicht die Mittel fehlen, sondern der Wille.
keyPhrase.en: It is not the means that are lacking, but the will.

lessons.title: Cultural References & Idioms
lessons.summary: Decode the allusions that make German speakers laugh — or fall silent.
objectives: Recognise references to German cultural history.
Explain the origin and meaning of common idioms.
Choose when an allusion is appropriate in conversation.

keyPhrase.de: Diese Anspielung versteht nur, wer die Geschichte kennt.
keyPhrase.en: Only someone who knows the history understands this allusion.

modules.title: Academic & Professional
modules.summary: Complex writing, precise summary and diplomatic communication.

lessons.title: Complex Academic Writing
lessons.summary: Abstracts, research questions and a coherent line of argument.
objectives: Write an abstract that states aim, method and finding.
Build a clear thesis and consistent terminology.
Use citation and hedging language accurately.

keyPhrase.de: Die vorliegende Arbeit untersucht die Wechselwirkung zwischen …
keyPhrase.en: The present paper examines the interaction between …

lessons.title: Interpretation & Summary
lessons.summary: Paraphrase without losing meaning and summarise without losing nuance.
objectives: Summarise a complex argument in a defined length.
Paraphrase accurately while avoiding plagiarism.
Separate an author's position from your own.

keyPhrase.en: In summary, it can be stated that …

lessons.title: Nuanced Professional Communication
lessons.summary: Diplomatic language for high-stakes professional situations.
objectives: Soften criticism without making it vague.
Use diplomatic suggestions and proposals.
Adapt formality to hierarchy and culture.

keyPhrase.de: Wir regen an, den Vorschlag erneut zu prüfen.
keyPhrase.en: We suggest reviewing the proposal again.

modules.title: Native-Like Fluency
modules.summary: Debate, improvise and refine until German feels like yours.

lessons.title: Sophisticated Debates
lessons.summary: Frame, challenge and rebut in real time without losing composure.
objectives: Frame a debate around a clear question.
Challenge an assumption politely but directly.
Rebutt an argument with evidence and structure.

keyPhrase.de: Man kann die Frage auch aus einer anderen Perspektive betrachten.
keyPhrase.en: One can also consider the question from another perspective.

lessons.title: Spontaneous Conversation Strategies
lessons.summary: Paraphrase, repair and keep the conversation moving when words go missing.
objectives: Paraphrase around an unknown word.
Repair your own sentence naturally.
Use fillers and discourse markers like a fluent speaker.

keyPhrase.de: Wie sagt man das? Ich meine …
keyPhrase.en: How do you say that? I mean …

lessons.title: Precision Workshop
lessons.summary: Connotation, collocation and the difference between correct and right.
objectives: Choose between near-synonyms by connotation.
Correct unnatural collocations in a text.
Explain why a word is misleading in context.

keyPhrase.de: Der Begriff ist in diesem Zusammenhang irreführend.
keyPhrase.en: The term is misleading in this context.
